notes.proportions: Every ratio here is DESIGN.md's lockup table, not a fresh decision. wordmarkCapHeight, symbolGap, and stackedGap are multiples of the symbol height S; productCapHeight is a multiple of the wordmark cap height and productBaseline is that cap height again, measured down from the wordmark baseline.
notes.typeMetrics: Cap height, descender, and per-character advances come from brand/source/public-sans-metrics.json, extracted from the pinned font by scripts/extract-font-metrics.py. Advances exclude kerning, so a generated canvas reserves marginally more width than the text needs.
notes.productLeftEdge: Flush with the mark's left edge, not the wordmark's. DESIGN.md says 'left edges flush' for the second line of the product lockup; this is the reading consumers already derived by hand.
notes.productTracking: Not specified by DESIGN.md, so the product line sets untracked.
